Babou.ai | Remote | Full Time

Hiring: Executive Assistant

Babou.ai is an early-stage AI company building novel autonomous systems for creative production.

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to work directly with the CEO. High-ownership role across inbox, calendar, communications, project management, and internal coordination. You’ll build systems, track priorities, and keep the company organized.

Looking for someone sharp and hungry with high agency. Startup experience preferred but not required. 4+ years experience is a plus, but we’d take an exceptional recent graduate over a mediocre tenured EA. Fluent English, strong judgment, self-starter, and real interest in technology required. Must operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

Fully remote. Competitive compensation.

Apply: careers@babou.ai

Subject: "EA - [Your Name]"
